name: Arrow
description:
Arrows for use with bows.

Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

name: Crusher
description:
Facility for breaking down Stone and Wood to exchange them for other materials.

Requires Pal with the Watering trait to spin the water turbine.

name: Heater
description:
A device that blows warm air, raising the temperature of a base.

It doesn't provide much warmth, but helps one to endure somewhat cold environments.

Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

name: Cooler
description:
A device that blows cool air, lowering the temperature of a base.

It doesn't provide much relief from the heat, but helps one to endure somewhat hot environments.

Requires an Ice Pal for cooling.

name: Cement
description:
Cement used for creating structures and more.

Can be produced in a High Quality Workbench.

name: Stone Gate
description:
Gate large enough for big Pals to pass through.

Made from stone, it is reasonably sturdy.

name: Musket
description:
Simple, old fashioned gun. 

Fires a single, powerful shot at the expense of a long reload time.

name: Clinic
description:
A basic medical facility for managing the health of Pals working at the base.

Assigning a Pal with Medicine Production suitability helps reduce SAN depletion and prevent illness and injury.

While sanitation has its limits, it plays a crucial role in early base development.

name: Silo
description:
Place in base to improve planting speed.

Placing more than one has no additional effect.

name: Lamp
description:
A light source that provides illumination to a base even at night.

Requires electricity, but lights up a larger area.

name: Brothers of the Eternal Pyre Flag Set
Polymer
description:
Polymer made from refined oil. 

Required for producing various advanced items such as firearms.

Can be crafted at Production Assembly Line.

name: Snowman
description:
Place in base to improve cooling speed.

Placing more than one has no additional effect.

name: Corrosive Solvent
description:
A dangerous chemical solvent with strong decomposing properties.

Used for precision processing and special treatments.

Can be crafted at Production Assembly Line.

name: Refrigerator
description:
Large food vault.

Assign an Ice Pal to help prevent

food stored inside from spoiling.

name: PAL Genetic Research Unit Flag Set
